# 4. Downstream Analyses with Pseudobulking


```{r PseudobulkPreprocessing, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# Pseudobulk + Log2FC (WT vs KI) per Tissue — Final Inline GSEA Version
# ============================================================

library(Matrix)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(tibble)

# --- Step 1. Relabel Genotype column if numeric (0 = WT, 1 = KI)
for (tissue in names(gene_filtered_list)) {
  obj <- gene_filtered_list[[tissue]]
  meta <- obj@meta.data
  
  # If Genotype exists and is numeric → convert
  if ("Genotype" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    if (is.numeric(meta$Genotype) || is.logical(meta$Genotype)) {
      meta$Genotype <- ifelse(meta$Genotype == 0, "WT",
                              ifelse(meta$Genotype == 1, "KI", NA))
    }
  } else if ("ID" %in% colnames(meta)) {
    meta$Genotype <- ifelse(grepl("WT", meta$ID, ignore.case = TRUE), "WT", "KI")
  } else {
    warning(sprintf("⚠️ No Genotype or ID column found for %s", tissue))
  }
  
  obj@meta.data <- meta
  gene_filtered_list[[tissue]] <- obj
}






# --- Step 2. Compute Pseudobulk + Log2FC
log2fc_results <- list()
log2fc_results_full <- list()

for (tissue in names(gene_filtered_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  obj <- gene_filtered_list[[tissue]]
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RawCounts"
  
  counts <- GetAssayData(obj, slot = "counts")
  meta <- obj@meta.data
  
  # Identify WT and KI cells
  wt_cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$Genotype == "WT"]
  KI_cells <- rownames(meta)[meta$Genotype == "KI"]
  
  if (length(wt_cells) == 0 | length(KI_cells) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ %s: Missing WT or KI cells — skipped.\n", tissue))
    cat("</details>\n\n")
    next
  }
  
  # --- Pseudobulk per genotype
  pb_WT <- as.numeric(Matrix::rowSums(counts[, wt_cells, drop = FALSE]))
  pb_KI <- as.numeric(Matrix::rowSums(counts[, KI_cells, drop = FALSE]))
  names(pb_WT) <- rownames(counts)
  names(pb_KI) <- rownames(counts)
  
  # --- Compute log2FC
  pseudocount <- 1
  
  # CPM normalization
  # --- CPM normalization (ensure correct column names)
  pb_mat <- cbind(WT = pb_WT, KI = pb_KI)   # ✅ explicitly name columns
  pb_cpm <- edgeR::cpm(pb_mat, log = FALSE, prior.count = 0)

  # Sanity check: skip if WT or KI column missing 
  if (!all(c("WT", "KI") %in% colnames(pb_cpm))) {
    cat(sprintf("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ %s: Missing WT or KI after CPM normalization — skipped.</p>\n", tissue))
    cat("</details>\n\n")
    next
  }

  pb_WT <- pb_cpm[, "WT"]
  pb_KI <- pb_cpm[, "KI"]

  log2FC <- log2((pb_KI + pseudocount) / (pb_WT + pseudocount))
  
  # --- Full results (for GSEA)
  res_df_full <- data.frame(
    Gene = names(log2FC),
    log2FC = as.numeric(log2FC),
    KI_count = pb_KI,
    WT_count = pb_WT,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  log2fc_results_full[[tissue]] <- res_df_full
  
  # --- Top 300 for summary display
  res_df <- res_df_full %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    slice_head(n = 300)
  log2fc_results[[tissue]] <- res_df
  
  print(kable(res_df, format = "html",
              digits = 2,
              table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered table-striped' ",
              caption = paste("Top 300 Genes by |log2FC| —", tissue)))
  
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}





# --- Step 3. Plot top 100 genes per tissue (clean labels, single plot)
cat("<hr><h2>Top 100 log2FC Genes (KI vs WT) per Tissue</h2>\n")

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results)) {
  df <- log2fc_results[[tissue]]
  top100 <- head(df, 100)

  # --- Dynamic plot height (increase scaling to avoid overlap)
  plot_height <- max(8, nrow(top100) * 0.22)   # 🔹 taller scaling: 0.22" per gene
  
  p <- ggplot(top100, aes(x = reorder(Gene, log2FC), y = log2FC, fill = log2FC > 0)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("TRUE" = "firebrick", "FALSE" = "steelblue")) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    theme(
      axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 4.3),     # 🔹 slightly smaller labels
      axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 8),
      plot.title   = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      legend.title = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.x = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      axis.title.y = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 10, face = "bold"),
      plot.margin  = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Top 100 log2FC genes —", tissue),
      x = "Gene",
      y = "log<sub>2</sub>FC (<i>Wnt1</i><sup>G177C/G177C</sup> / <i>Wnt1</i><sup>+/+</sup>)",
      fill = "Up in <i>Wnt1</i><sup>G177C/G177C</sup>?"
    )

  # --- Print only once (remove duplication)
  print(p)

  # --- Add note below each plot (optional)
  cat(sprintf("<br><em>Plot height ≈ %.1f inches</em><br><br>\n", plot_height))
}



# ============================================================
# Global Gene Regulation Summary — log2FC Distribution per Tissue
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(htmltools)

cat("<hr><h2>Global log<sub>2</sub>FC Distribution per Tissue (KI vs WT)</h2>\n")

# --- Initialize summary table
summary_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  log2fc_vals <- df$log2FC

  # --- Compute descriptive statistics
  stats <- data.frame(
    Tissue = tissue,
    Min = round(min(log2fc_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Q1  = round(quantile(log2fc_vals, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Median = round(median(log2fc_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Mean = round(mean(log2fc_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Q3 = round(quantile(log2fc_vals, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Max = round(max(log2fc_vals, na.rm = TRUE), 3),
    Pct_Upregulated = round(mean(log2fc_vals > 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1),
    Pct_Downregulated = round(mean(log2fc_vals < 0, na.rm = TRUE) * 100, 1)
  )

  summary_list[[tissue]] <- stats

  # --- Plot histogram per tissue
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = log2FC)) +
    geom_histogram(
      bins = 50,
      fill = "steelblue",
      color = "white",
      alpha = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    labs(
      # Proper log₂ notation
      title = bquote("log"[2]*"FC Distribution — "*.(tissue)),
      x = expression(log[2]*"(KI / WT)"),
      y = "Frequency"
    )

  print(p)
  cat("<br><br>\n")
}

# --- Combine summaries into one table
summary_df <- bind_rows(summary_list)

# --- Add interpretation column
summary_df <- summary_df %>%
  mutate(Global_Trend = case_when(
    Pct_Upregulated > 60 ~ "Predominantly Upregulated in KI",
    Pct_Downregulated > 60 ~ "Predominantly Downregulated in KI",
    TRUE ~ "Mixed Regulation"
  ))

# --- Display summary table
cat("<h3>Summary Statistics of log<sub>2</sub>FC per Tissue</h3>\n")

print(
  knitr::kable(
    summary_df,
    format = "html",
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' 
                  style='width:100%; font-size:80%;'",
    caption = "Descriptive statistics of log₂FC values per tissue"
  )
)

cat("<p><em>Interpretation:</em> Columns show the overall log₂FC range and average direction of change. 
The % Upregulated and % Downregulated columns describe the proportion of genes with positive or negative 
log₂FC values. The Global Trend column indicates whether each tissue is globally upregulated, 
downregulated, or mixed in <i>Wnt1<sup>G177C/G177C</sup></i> vs WT.</p>")
```


```{r PseudobulkPreprocessing2, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE, fig.width=18, fig.height=16}

# ========================================================================================
# Inline Venn Diagrams + Intersection + Unique Tables (Per-Tissue log2FC)
# Common & Unique DE Genes (|log₂FC| ≥ 1)
# ========================================================================================

library(dplyr)
library(ggvenn)
library(gridExtra)
library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(knitr)
library(purrr)
library(scales)

cat("<hr><h2>Venn Diagrams + Gene Tables — Common & Unique DE Genes (|log<sub>2</sub>FC| ≥ 1)</h2>\n")

# --- Collect DE gene sets per tissue
venn_up   <- list()
venn_down <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) next
  
  up_genes <- df %>% filter(log2FC >= 1) %>% select(Gene, log2FC)
  down_genes <- df %>% filter(log2FC <= -1) %>% select(Gene, log2FC)
  
  venn_up[[tissue]]   <- up_genes
  venn_down[[tissue]] <- down_genes
}

# --- Keep tissues with at least a few DE genes
valid_tissues <- names(venn_up)[sapply(venn_up, nrow) > 0 | sapply(venn_down, nrow) > 0]

if (length(valid_tissues) >= 2) {
  cat(sprintf("<details open><summary><strong>Global Venn — %s tissues</strong></summary>\n", length(valid_tissues)))
  
  # --- Create gene name lists (for Venn drawing)
  venn_up_list   <- lapply(venn_up[valid_tissues],   \(x) x$Gene)
  venn_down_list <- lapply(venn_down[valid_tissues], \(x) x$Gene)
  
  # --- Optional: shorten long labels for better fit
  #shorten_names <- function(x) {
    #x <- gsub("CorticalBone", "Cortical", x)
    #x <- gsub("CallusBone", "Callus", x)
    #x <- gsub("Cartilage", "Cart", x)
    #x <- gsub("Muscl", "Muscle", x)
    #x
  #}
  #names(venn_up_list)   <- shorten_names(names(venn_up_list))
  #names(venn_down_list) <- shorten_names(names(venn_down_list))
  
  # ============================================================
  # Enhanced Venn diagrams — more margin, reduced overlap
  # ============================================================
  venn_up_plot <- ggvenn(
    venn_up_list,
    fill_color = alpha(c("#377EB8", "#E41A1C", "#4DAF4A", "#984EA3", "#FF7F00"), 0.6),
    stroke_size = 0.6,
    set_name_size = 6,
    text_size = 3.8,
    show_percentage = FALSE
  ) +
    ggtitle(bquote("Upregulated (" * log[2] * "FC ≥ 1)")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(30, 30, 30, 30),
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-7, 7), ylim = c(-7, 7))
  
  venn_down_plot <- ggvenn(
    venn_down_list,
    fill_color = alpha(c("#A6D854", "#E5C494", "#B3B3B3", "#8DD3C7", "#FB8072"), 0.6),
    stroke_size = 0.6,
    set_name_size = 6,
    text_size = 3.8,
    show_percentage = FALSE
  ) +
    ggtitle(bquote("Downregulated (" * log[2] * "FC ≤ -1)")) +
    theme(
      plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
      plot.margin = margin(30, 30, 30, 30),
      text = element_text(family = "sans"),
      legend.position = "none"
    ) +
    coord_equal(xlim = c(-7, 7), ylim = c(-7, 7))
  
  # ============================================================
  # Render each Venn separately in collapsible HTML sections
  # ============================================================
  cat("<details open><summary><strong>Upregulated (log₂FC ≥ 1)</strong></summary>")
  print(venn_up_plot)
  cat("</details>")

  cat("<details open><summary><strong>Downregulated (log₂FC ≤ -1)</strong></summary>")
  print(venn_down_plot)
  cat("</details>")
  
  # ============================================================
  # Summary table
  # ============================================================
  summary_df <- tibble(
    Tissue = valid_tissues,
    Upregulated   = sapply(venn_up[valid_tissues], nrow),
    Downregulated = sapply(venn_down[valid_tissues], nrow),
    Total_DE      = Upregulated + Downregulated
  )
  
  cat("<br><h4>Summary of DE genes per tissue (|log₂FC| ≥ 1)</h4>\n")
  print(knitr::kable(
    summary_df,
    format = "html",
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' style='width:75%; font-size:85%;'",
    caption = "Counts of up- and downregulated genes (|log₂FC| ≥ 1) per tissue"
  ))
  cat("</details>\n")
  
  # ============================================================
  # Intersection tables (with log2FC values from each tissue)
  # ============================================================
  cat("<hr><h3>Intersection Gene Tables (Upregulated / Downregulated, per-tissue log₂FC)</h3>\n")
  
  # --- Helper: get intersection for subset of tissues with per-tissue log2FC
  get_intersect_df <- function(tissue_subset, venn_data) {
    common_genes <- Reduce(intersect, lapply(venn_data[tissue_subset], \(x) x$Gene))
    if (length(common_genes) == 0) return(NULL)
    
    reduce(
      tissue_subset,
      function(df, t) {
        vals <- venn_data[[t]] %>%
          filter(Gene %in% common_genes) %>%
          select(Gene, !!paste0("log2FC_", t) := log2FC)
        if (is.null(df)) vals else full_join(df, vals, by = "Gene")
      },
      .init = NULL
    )
  }
  
  # --- Define intersections to show (all & pairwise)
  combos <- c(list(valid_tissues), combn(valid_tissues, 2, simplify = FALSE))
  
  for (combo in combos) {
    label <- paste(combo, collapse = " ∩ ")
    
    # --- Upregulated intersections
    up_df <- get_intersect_df(combo, venn_up)
    if (!is.null(up_df)) {
      cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>Upregulated — %s</strong></summary>\n", label))
      print(knitr::kable(
        up_df %>% arrange(desc(rowMeans(select(., starts_with("log2FC_")), na.rm = TRUE))),
        format = "html",
        table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' style=\"width:95%%; font-size:80%%;\"",
        caption = paste("Common upregulated genes (log₂FC ≥ 1) —", label)
      ))
      cat("</details>\n")
    }
    
    # --- Downregulated intersections
    down_df <- get_intersect_df(combo, venn_down)
    if (!is.null(down_df)) {
      cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>Downregulated — %s</strong></summary>\n", label))
      print(knitr::kable(
        down_df %>% arrange(rowMeans(select(., starts_with("log2FC_")), na.rm = TRUE)),
        format = "html",
        table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' style=\"width:95%%; font-size:80%%;\"",
        caption = paste("Common downregulated genes (log₂FC ≤ –1) —", label)
      ))
      cat("</details>\n")
    }
  }

  # ============================================================
  # Unique gene tables (Upregulated / Downregulated per tissue)
  # ============================================================
  cat("<hr><h3>Unique Gene Tables per Tissue (Upregulated / Downregulated)</h3>\n")
  
  for (t in valid_tissues) {
    # --- Upregulated unique
    others <- setdiff(valid_tissues, t)
    unique_up <- venn_up[[t]] %>%
      filter(!Gene %in% unlist(lapply(venn_up[others], \(x) x$Gene)))
    
    if (nrow(unique_up) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>Upregulated — Unique to %s</strong></summary>\n", t))
      print(knitr::kable(
        unique_up %>% arrange(desc(log2FC)),
        format = "html",
        table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' style=\"width:85%%; font-size:85%%;\"",
        caption = paste("Genes upregulated only in", t, "(log₂FC ≥ 1)")
      ))
      cat("</details>\n")
    }
    
    # --- Downregulated unique
    unique_down <- venn_down[[t]] %>%
      filter(!Gene %in% unlist(lapply(venn_down[others], \(x) x$Gene)))
    
    if (nrow(unique_down) > 0) {
      cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>Downregulated — Unique to %s</strong></summary>\n", t))
      print(knitr::kable(
        unique_down %>% arrange(log2FC),
        format = "html",
        table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' style=\"width:85%%; font-size:85%%;\"",
        caption = paste("Genes downregulated only in", t, "(log₂FC ≤ –1)")
      ))
      cat("</details>\n")
    }
  }
  
} else {
  cat("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ Not enough tissues with |log₂FC| ≥ 1 genes to draw Venn diagrams or compute intersections.</p>\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> Adjusted margins and coordinate limits prevent label cutoff; reduced text overlap for better readability in 5-way Venn diagrams.</p>\n")
```

```{r PseudobulkPreprocessing3, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

# ========================================================================================
# Inline MA Plots per Tissue (no saving) — pseudobulk log₂FC vs mean expression
# ========================================================================================

library(ggplot2)
library(htmltools)
library(scales)
library(dplyr)
library(ggrepel)
library(knitr)
library(tidyr)

cat("<hr><h2>MA Plots — log₂FC vs mean expression per tissue</h2>\n")

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  
  # --- Defensive checks
  if (is.null(df) || !is.data.frame(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("<p style='color:gray;'>⚠️ %s — skipped (no data or not a data frame)</p>\n", tissue))
    next
  }

  # --- Ensure df is a flat tibble (avoid list columns)
  df <- as_tibble(df)
  df <- df %>% mutate(across(everything(), ~ if (is.list(.x)) as.character(.x) else .x))

  # --- Compute mean expression (average pseudobulk counts)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      MeanExpr = log10((WT_count + KI_count) / 2 + 1),
      Significant = case_when(
        log2FC >= 1  ~ "Upregulated",
        log2FC <= -1 ~ "Downregulated",
        TRUE         ~ "Not significant"
      )
    )

  # --- Classify genes by zero-count pattern between groups
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      ZeroPattern = case_when(
        WT_count == 0 & KI_count == 0 ~ "Both 0",
        WT_count == 0 & KI_count > 0  ~ "WT=0 (only in KI)",
        KI_count == 0 & WT_count > 0  ~ "KI=0 (only in WT)",
        TRUE                          ~ "Expressed in both"
      )
    )

  # --- Define expression class (for visualization)
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(ExpressionClass = ifelse(MeanExpr > 1, "Expressed (stable FC)", "Low/Undetected (unstable FC)"))

  # --- Filter out very lowly expressed genes for stability
  df <- df %>% filter(WT_count > 5 | KI_count > 5)

  # --- Count up/downregulated genes
  n_up   <- sum(df$log2FC >= 1, na.rm = TRUE)
  n_down <- sum(df$log2FC <= -1, na.rm = TRUE)

  # --- Select top 20 DE genes (stable expression, high MeanExpr)
  top_up <- df %>%
    filter(log2FC >= 1, MeanExpr > 2) %>%
    arrange(desc(log2FC * MeanExpr)) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(Highlight_Type = "Upregulated (log₂FC ≥ 1, MeanExpr > 2)")

  top_down <- df %>%
    filter(log2FC <= -1, MeanExpr > 2) %>%
    arrange(log2FC * MeanExpr) %>%
    slice_head(n = 20) %>%
    mutate(Highlight_Type = "Downregulated (log₂FC ≤ -1, MeanExpr > 2)")

  top_genes <- bind_rows(top_up, top_down)

  # --- MA plot (ZeroPattern overlay via shape)
  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = MeanExpr, y = log2FC, color = Significant, shape = ZeroPattern)) +
    annotate("rect", xmin = 0, xmax = 1, ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,
             fill = "gray95", alpha = 0.6) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.5) +
    geom_density_2d(color = "gray70", alpha = 0.3) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
    geom_hline(yintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dotted", color = "gray60") +
    scale_color_manual(
      values = c(
        "Upregulated" = "firebrick",
        "Downregulated" = "steelblue",
        "Not significant" = "gray70"
      )
    ) +
    scale_shape_manual(
      values = c("Both 0" = 4, "WT=0 (only in KI)" = 17, "KI=0 (only in WT)" = 15, "Expressed in both" = 16)
    ) +
    labs(
      title = bquote("MA Plot — " ~ .(tissue) ~ "(Top 20 genes ranked by log" [2] * "FC × MeanExpr)"),
      x = "Mean expression (log<sub>10</sub> average counts)",
      y = "log<sub>2</sub> fold change (KI / WT)",
      color = "Status",
      shape = "Zero-count pattern"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
      plot.title    = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      axis.title.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(),
      axis.title.y  = ggtext::element_markdown()
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = max(df$MeanExpr, na.rm = TRUE), y = 1.2,
             label = paste0("Up: ", n_up), hjust = 1, color = "firebrick", size = 3.5) +
    annotate("text", x = max(df$MeanExpr, na.rm = TRUE), y = -1.2,
             label = paste0("Down: ", n_down), hjust = 1, color = "steelblue", size = 3.5) +
    geom_text_repel(
      data = top_genes,
      aes(label = Gene),
      size = 3,
      box.padding = 0.6,
      point.padding = 0.3,
      min.segment.length = 0.2,
      max.overlaps = Inf,
      force = 10,
      segment.color = "gray50",
      color = "black"
    )

  # --- Collapsible display
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s</strong> — MA Plot + Summary</summary>\n", tissue))
  print(p)

  # --- Summary of DE directionality
  summary_tbl <- df %>%
    summarize(
      Tissue = tissue,
      n_genes = n(),
      n_up = sum(log2FC >= 1),
      n_down = sum(log2FC <= -1),
      pct_up = round(mean(log2FC >= 1) * 100, 1),
      pct_down = round(mean(log2FC <= -1) * 100, 1),
      mean_log2FC = round(mean(log2FC, na.rm = TRUE), 2)
    )
  print(knitr::kable(summary_tbl, caption = paste("Summary of DE directionality —", tissue)))

  # --- Table of zero-count pattern frequencies
  zero_tbl <- df %>%
    group_by(ZeroPattern) %>%
    summarise(n = n()) %>%
    mutate(Percent = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1))
  print(knitr::kable(zero_tbl, caption = paste("Zero-count pattern summary —", tissue)))

  # --- Table of highlighted genes
  if (nrow(top_genes) > 0) {
    highlight_tbl <- top_genes %>%
      select(Gene, log2FC, MeanExpr, Highlight_Type, ZeroPattern) %>%
      arrange(desc(abs(log2FC)))
    print(knitr::kable(highlight_tbl, caption = paste("Highlighted Top 30 DE Genes —", tissue)))
  } else {
    cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No highlighted genes for this tissue (no DE genes with log₂FC ±1 and MeanExpr > 2).</p>\n")
  }
  
    # --- Export full MA-plot data (per tissue)
    out_dir <- "MAplot_Excels"
    if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir)

    export_df <- df %>%
      dplyr::select(
        Gene,
        WT_count,
        KI_count,
        log2FC,
        MeanExpr,
        Significant,
        ZeroPattern,
        ExpressionClass
      )

    out_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("MAplot_", tissue, "_data.xlsx"))

    tryCatch({
      writexl::write_xlsx(export_df, out_path)
      cat(sprintf("<p style='color:green;'>💾 Exported MA-plot data for %s → %s</p>\n", tissue, out_path))
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat(sprintf("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ Failed to export MA-plot data for %s: %s</p>\n", tissue, e$message))
    })


  cat("</details><br>\n")
}

The gray-shaded region marks low expression (unstable FC). Red = upregulated, blue = downregulated.  
Labeled genes correspond to the top 20 up- and down-regulated genes ranked by (log₂FC × MeanExpr).

# ========================================================================================
# Export all log₂FC values per tissue to Excel (folder: log2FCValues)
# ========================================================================================

library(openxlsx)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

cat("<hr><h2>Exporting full log₂FC results per tissue</h2>\n")

# --- Create export folder
out_dir <- "log2FCValues"
if (!dir.exists(out_dir)) dir.create(out_dir)

# --- Loop through tissues and export
for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("<p style='color:gray;'>⚠️ %s — skipped (no data found)</p>\n", tissue))
    next
  }
  
  # Sort for easier viewing (highest |log2FC| first)
  df_out <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(log2FC))) %>%
    mutate(Rank_by_abs_log2FC = row_number())
  
  # Define output file path
  file_path <- file.path(out_dir, paste0("log2FC_", tissue, ".xlsx"))
  
  # Write Excel file
  openxlsx::write.xlsx(df_out, file_path, overwrite = TRUE)
  
  cat(sprintf("<p>✅ <strong>%s</strong> exported — %d genes written.</p>\n", file_path, nrow(df_out)))
}

cat(sprintf("<p><em>All files saved inside:</em> <code>%s</code></p>\n", normalizePath(out_dir)))







# ============================================================
# GSEA per tissue (Hallmark) — standardized ranks, 100k perms,
# bidirectional coloring, smaller table font, and summary heatmap
# ============================================================

library(dplyr)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(knitr)
library(pheatmap)
library(tibble)
library(htmltools)

cat("<hr><h2>GSEA (Hallmark) per Tissue — Standardized log₂FC Ranks</h2>\n")

# --- Get Hallmark gene sets for mouse (50 curated pathways) ---
msig_hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H") %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)


# --- Optional Pathway Sets GO and REACTOME ---

#msig_go <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")
#msig_reactome <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")


# --- Container for NES across tissues (for heatmap)
gsea_matrix_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 1. Prepare standardized and named ranks or Use raw log2FC values (no z-scaling) to keep biological fold-change magnitudes intact
  # ============================================================
  
  #gene_ranks <- scale(df$log2FC)              # z-score standardization
  #gene_ranks <- as.numeric(gene_ranks)        # convert matrix → numeric
                  
  gene_ranks <- df$log2FC                      # Use raw log2FC values (no z-scaling)
  
  names(gene_ranks) <- df$Gene                # add gene names
  gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 2. Run fgsea with high permutation count
  # ============================================================
  fgsea_res <- fgsea(
    pathways = msig_hallmark,
    stats = gene_ranks,
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500,
    nperm = 100000
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 3. Clean pathway names and format leading-edge genes
  # ============================================================
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("_", " ", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(fgsea_res$pathway))
  
  # Add log2FC for each leading-edge gene
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgsea_res$leadingEdge, function(x) {
    genes <- x
    log2fc_vals <- df$log2FC[match(genes, df$Gene)]
    pairs <- paste0(genes, " (", round(log2fc_vals, 2), ")")
    paste(pairs, collapse = ", ")
  })
  
  # Wrap leadingEdge in styled div
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- paste0(
    "<div style='white-space:normal; word-wrap:break-word; text-align:left; max-width:600px;'>",
    fgsea_res$leadingEdge,
    "</div>"
  )
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 4. Label significance and direction
  # ============================================================
  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Significance = case_when(
        padj <= 0.05 ~ "Significant (adj p ≤ 0.05)",
        padj <= 0.25 ~ "Suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25)",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  # Optional mild filter (remove noisy p > 0.1)
  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>% filter(pval <= 0.1)
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 5. Color by direction & adjusted p-value
  # ============================================================
  fgsea_res$pathway <- ifelse(
    fgsea_res$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res$Direction == "Upregulated",
    paste0("<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>", fgsea_res$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔴 up
    ifelse(fgsea_res$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res$Direction == "Downregulated",
           paste0("<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>", fgsea_res$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔵 down
           ifelse(fgsea_res$padj <= 0.25,
                  paste0("<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>", fgsea_res$pathway, "</span>"),  # 🟠 suggestive
                  fgsea_res$pathway))
  )
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 6. Store NES for summary heatmap  ✅ (fixed version)
  # ============================================================

  gsea_matrix_list[[tissue]] <- fgsea_res %>%
    select(pathway, NES) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!rlang::sym(tissue) := NES)
  
  # ============================================================
  # --- Step 7. Print collapsible GSEA table per tissue
  # ============================================================
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — Hallmark GSEA Enrichment</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  # Remove 'Direction' column before displaying (keep others)
  fgsea_display <- fgsea_res %>% select(-Direction)
  
  print(knitr::kable(
    fgsea_res,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    digits = 3,
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' 
                  style='width:100%; table-layout:auto; word-wrap:break-word; font-size:70%;'",
    caption = paste("Hallmark GSEA Results (p ≤ 0.1 shown) —", tissue)
  ))
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> 
<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>Red bold</strong> = significantly upregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>Blue bold</strong> = significantly downregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>Orange</span> = suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25, raw p ≤ 0.1).</p>\n")


# --- Save for downstream venn diagram comparisons
gsea_log2fc_list <- gsea_matrix_list

# ============================================================
# --- Step 8. Cross-Tissue Summary Heatmap of NES
# ============================================================

cat("<hr><h2>Cross-Tissue Summary — Hallmark GSEA NES Heatmap</h2>\n")

# Merge all tissues into one NES matrix
gsea_matrix <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "pathway"), gsea_matrix_list)
rownames(gsea_matrix) <- gsea_matrix$pathway
gsea_matrix <- gsea_matrix[, -1]
gsea_matrix[is.na(gsea_matrix)] <- 0

# Heatmap of normalized enrichment scores (NES)
pheatmap(
  gsea_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  main = "Hallmark Pathway Enrichment (NES across tissues)",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  border_color = NA
)
```

```{r PseudobulkPreprocessing4, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# ==================================================================================================
# Tissue-Specific Gene Enrichment (≥2× higher than all other tissues, exclude self from comparisons)
# Split into: (2×–10×) and (≥10×)
# Additional condition: gene must be expressed (>0) in at least one other tissue
# ==================================================================================================

library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)
library(htmltools)

cat("<hr><h2>Tissue-Specific Gene Enrichment (≥2× higher than all other tissues, expressed in ≥1 other tissue)</h2>\n")

# --- Guard: ensure object exists
if (!exists("log2fc_results_full") || length(log2fc_results_full) == 0) {
  cat("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ 'log2fc_results_full' not found or empty. "
      ,"Make sure the PseudobulkPreprocessing chunk runs earlier in this Rmd.</p>\n", sep = "")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

# ============================================================
# --- Build expression matrices for WT and KI (auto-detect KI/KO)
# ============================================================

wt_list <- list()
KI_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ Skipping %s — NULL or empty dataframe.<br>\n", tissue))
    next
  }

  # detect KI/KO column
  if ("KI_count" %in% colnames(df)) {
    KI_col <- "KI_count"
  } else if ("KO_count" %in% colnames(df)) {
    KI_col <- "KO_count"
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ Skipping %s — missing KI_count/KO_count column.<br>\n", tissue))
    next
  }

  if (!"WT_count" %in% colnames(df)) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ Skipping %s — missing WT_count column.<br>\n", tissue))
    next
  }

  wt_list[[tissue]] <- df$WT_count
  KI_list[[tissue]] <- df[[KI_col]]
  names(wt_list[[tissue]]) <- df$Gene
  names(KI_list[[tissue]]) <- df$Gene
}

if (length(wt_list) == 0 || length(KI_list) == 0) {
  cat("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ No tissues with both WT_count and KI_count — aborting.</p>\n")
  knitr::knit_exit()
}

# ============================================================
# --- Merge into full matrices (use union of genes)
# ============================================================

common_genes <- Reduce(union, lapply(log2fc_results_full, function(x) x$Gene))
fill_missing_genes <- function(gene_vec, all_genes) {
  y <- gene_vec[all_genes]
  y[is.na(y)] <- 0
  return(y)
}

wt_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(wt_list, fill_missing_genes, all_genes = common_genes))
KI_mat <- do.call(cbind, lapply(KI_list, fill_missing_genes, all_genes = common_genes))
rownames(wt_mat) <- rownames(KI_mat) <- common_genes
colnames(wt_mat) <- names(wt_list)
colnames(KI_mat) <- names(KI_list)

cat(sprintf("<p>WT matrix: %d genes × %d tissues<br>KI matrix: %d genes × %d tissues</p>\n",
            nrow(wt_mat), ncol(wt_mat), nrow(KI_mat), ncol(KI_mat)))

# ============================================================
# --- Convert to log2CPM normalization
# ============================================================

wt_log2cpm <- edgeR::cpm(wt_mat, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
KI_log2cpm <- edgeR::cpm(KI_mat, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# ============================================================
# Combine Bone + Cortical into *only* Bone_Cortical (replace originals)
# ============================================================

make_bone_cortical_only <- function(expr_mat) {
  tissues <- colnames(expr_mat)
  if (all(c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone") %in% tissues)) {
    combined <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone")], na.rm = TRUE)
    expr_mat <- cbind(expr_mat[, setdiff(tissues, c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone")), drop = FALSE],
                      CallusBone_CorticalBone = combined)
  }
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[, sort(colnames(expr_mat)), drop = FALSE]
  return(expr_mat)
}

# keep copies before replacement
wt_log2cpm_original <- wt_log2cpm
KI_log2cpm_original <- KI_log2cpm

# replace Bone+Cortical with combined version for this analysis only
wt_log2cpm <- make_bone_cortical_only(wt_log2cpm)
KI_log2cpm <- make_bone_cortical_only(KI_log2cpm)

# also make raw count matrices for the "expressed in ≥1 other tissue" condition
wt_mat_raw <- make_bone_cortical_only(wt_mat)
KI_mat_raw <- make_bone_cortical_only(KI_mat)

# ==========================================================================================================
# Function: find tissue-specific genes (strict Option A: all ≥2×, at least one <10×)
# Additional filter: must be expressed (>0) in at least one other tissue
# ==========================================================================================================

find_tissue_specific_genes_split_expressed <- function(expr_mat, raw_mat,
                                                       fc_cutoff_low = 1, fc_cutoff_high = log2(10)) {
  tissue_specific <- list()
  tissues <- colnames(expr_mat)

  for (t in tissues) {
    log2fc_mat <- sweep(expr_mat, 1, expr_mat[, t], FUN = "-")
    comp_idx <- which(tissues != t)

    # Check if gene is expressed in ≥1 other tissue
    expressed_in_others <- apply(raw_mat[, comp_idx, drop = FALSE], 1,
                                 function(x) any(x > 0))

    # Strict logic across ALL comparisons
    is_low <- apply(log2fc_mat[, comp_idx, drop = FALSE], 1,
                    function(x) all(x <= -fc_cutoff_low) & any(x > -fc_cutoff_high))
    is_high <- apply(log2fc_mat[, comp_idx, drop = FALSE], 1,
                     function(x) all(x <= -fc_cutoff_high))

    genes_low  <- names(which(is_low & expressed_in_others))
    genes_high <- names(which(is_high & expressed_in_others))

    cat(sprintf("🧩 %s: %d genes 2×–10×, %d genes ≥10× higher (expressed in ≥1 other tissue)<br>\n",
                t, length(genes_low), length(genes_high)))

    make_df <- function(gene_set) {
      if (length(gene_set) == 0) return(data.frame())
      df <- as.data.frame(expr_mat[gene_set, , drop = FALSE])
      df <- cbind(Gene = rownames(df), df)
      min_fc <- apply(log2fc_mat[gene_set, comp_idx, drop = FALSE], 1, min)
      df$min_log2FC_vs_others <- min_fc
      df <- df |> arrange(desc(min_log2FC_vs_others))
      return(df)
    }

    tissue_specific[[t]] <- list(
      low  = make_df(genes_low),
      high = make_df(genes_high)
    )
  }
  return(tissue_specific)
}

# ============================================================
# Apply to WT and KI
# ============================================================

tissue_specific_WT <- find_tissue_specific_genes_split_expressed(wt_log2cpm, wt_mat_raw,
                                                                 fc_cutoff_low = 1, fc_cutoff_high = log2(10))
tissue_specific_KI <- find_tissue_specific_genes_split_expressed(KI_log2cpm, KI_mat_raw,
                                                                 fc_cutoff_low = 1, fc_cutoff_high = log2(10))

# ============================================================
# Collapsible Top-10 gene tables per tissue (split by fold-change range)
# ============================================================

cat("<hr><h4>Top 10 Tissue-Specific Genes per Tissue (expressed in ≥1 other tissue)</h4>\n")
for (genotype in c("WT", "KI")) {
  cat(sprintf("<h5>%s</h5>\n", genotype))
  lst <- if (genotype == "WT") tissue_specific_WT else tissue_specific_KI
  if (length(lst) == 0) {
    cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No tissues with specific genes for this genotype.</p>\n")
    next
  }
  for (tiss in names(lst)) {
    low_df  <- lst[[tiss]]$low
    high_df <- lst[[tiss]]$high

    cat(sprintf("<details><summary><b>%s</b></summary>", tiss))

    # 2×–10× genes
    cat("<details><summary>Genes ≥2× and <10× higher (expressed in ≥1 other tissue)</summary>")
    if (nrow(low_df) == 0) {
      cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No genes in this range.</p>")
    } else {
      cat(knitr::kable(head(low_df, 10), format = "html",
                       table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered'"))
    }
    cat("</details>")

    # ≥10× genes
    cat("<details><summary>Genes ≥10× higher (expressed in ≥1 other tissue)</summary>")
    if (nrow(high_df) == 0) {
      cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No genes in this range.</p>")
    } else {
      cat(knitr::kable(head(high_df, 10), format = "html",
                       table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered'"))
    }
    cat("</details>")

    cat("</details>\n")
  }
}

cat("<p><b>✅ Done! See tables above.</b></p>\n")

# ============================================================

wt_log2cpm <- wt_log2cpm_original

                                                            fc_cutoff_low = 1, fc_cutoff_high = log2(10))
tissue_specific_KI <- find_tissue_specific_genes_split_zero(KI_log2cpm, KI_mat_raw,
                                                            fc_cutoff_low = 1, fc_cutoff_high = log2(10))

# ============================================================
# Collapsible Top-10 gene tables per tissue (split by fold-change range)
# ============================================================

cat("<hr><h4>Top 10 Tissue-Specific Genes per Tissue (0 in others)</h4>\n")
for (genotype in c("WT", "KI")) {
  cat(sprintf("<h5>%s</h5>\n", genotype))
  lst <- if (genotype == "WT") tissue_specific_WT else tissue_specific_KI
  if (length(lst) == 0) {
    cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No tissues with specific genes for this genotype.</p>\n")
    next
  }
  for (tiss in names(lst)) {
    low_df  <- lst[[tiss]]$low
    high_df <- lst[[tiss]]$high

    cat(sprintf("<details><summary><b>%s</b></summary>", tiss))

    # 2×–10× genes
    cat("<details><summary>Genes ≥2× and <10× higher (0 in others)</summary>")
    if (nrow(low_df) == 0) {
      cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No genes in this range.</p>")
    } else {
      cat(knitr::kable(head(low_df, 10), format = "html",
                       table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered'"))
    }
    cat("</details>")

    # ≥10× genes
    cat("<details><summary>Genes ≥10× higher (0 in others)</summary>")
    if (nrow(high_df) == 0) {
      cat("<p style='color:gray;'>No genes in this range.</p>")
    } else {
      cat(knitr::kable(head(high_df, 10), format = "html",
                       table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered'"))
    }
    cat("</details>")

    cat("</details>\n")
  }
}

cat("<p><b>✅ Done! See tables above.</b></p>\n")

# ============================================================
# Restore original matrices (keep Bone and Cortical separate for future analysis)
# ============================================================

wt_log2cpm <- wt_log2cpm_original
KI_log2cpm <- KI_log2cpm_original










# ============================================================
# Known Tissue-Specific Marker Genes — Expression & Validation Highlights
# (✅ = enriched only if higher than *all* other tissues)
# ============================================================

library(edgeR)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

cat("<hr><h2>Known Tissue-Specific Marker Genes — Expression & Validation Highlights</h2>\n")

# --- Expanded marker gene panels per tissue
known_markers <- list(
  BM = c("Cd74", "Ptprc", "Lyz2", "Cd68", "Csf1r", "Cd14", "Mpo", "Itgam", "Cd3e",
         "Ms4a1", "Nkg7", "Ccl5", "Ctss", "Clec12a", "C1qa", "C1qb", "Laptm5",
         "H2-Ab1", "Tyrobp", "Trem2"),
  CallusBone = c("Col1a1", "Col1a2", "Bglap", "Ibsp", "Spp1", "Runx2", "Sp7", "Phex",
                 "Dmp1", "Mepe", "Alpl", "Ppap2b", "Ctnnb1", "Fgf23", "Ctsk", "Mmp13",
                 "Bmp2", "Bambi", "Sost", "Wnt10b"),
  Cartilage = c("Col2a1", "Acan", "Sox9", "Comp", "Matn1", "Col9a1", "Col11a1",
                "Chad", "Hapln1", "Prg4", "Cilp", "Cilp2", "Fxyd2", "Clec3a",
                "Lect1", "Frzb", "Car12", "Crtap", "Gp2", "Tnc"),
  CorticalBone = c("Snap25", "Syt1", "Grin1", "Grin2b", "Map2", "Rbfox3", "Dlg4",
                   "Camk2a", "Gad1", "Gad2", "Slc17a7", "Slc17a6", "Syp", "Nefm",
                   "Tubb3", "Syn1", "S100b", "Aqp4", "Gfap", "Pvalb"),
  Muscle = c("Acta1", "Myh1", "Myh2", "Myh4", "Myh7", "Ckm", "Des", "Tnnc2",
             "Tnni2", "Tnnt3", "Neb", "Mylpf", "Myl1", "Myod1", "Myog", "Cav3",
             "Dmd", "Pgam2", "Hspb7", "Tcap")
)

# ============================================================
# 🧩 Rename columns to ensure consistency before combining
# ============================================================

# Match expression matrix names to known_markers keys
rename_tissues_for_consistency <- function(mat) {
  cn <- colnames(mat)
  cn <- gsub("^CallusCartilage$", "Cartilage", cn)
  cn <- gsub("^CorticalBone$", "CallusBone_CorticalBone", cn)
  colnames(mat) <- cn
  return(mat)
}

wt_log2cpm <- rename_tissues_for_consistency(wt_log2cpm)
KI_log2cpm <- rename_tissues_for_consistency(KI_log2cpm)

# ============================================================
# 🧩 Combine CallusBone + CorticalBone into one composite "CallusBone_CorticalBone" tissue temporarily
# ============================================================

# --- Merge CorticalBone markers into CallusBone_CorticalBone
if (all(c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone") %in% names(known_markers))) {
  known_markers$CallusBone_CorticalBone <- unique(c(known_markers$CallusBone, known_markers$CorticalBone))
  known_markers$CallusBone <- NULL
  known_markers$CorticalBone <- NULL
}

# --- Function to merge CallusBone + CorticalBone expression into CallusBone_CorticalBone
combine_bone_tissues <- function(expr_mat) {
  tissues <- colnames(expr_mat)
  if (all(c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone") %in% tissues)) {
    combined <- rowMeans(expr_mat[, c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone")], na.rm = TRUE)
    expr_mat <- cbind(expr_mat[, setdiff(tissues, c("CallusBone", "CorticalBone")), drop = FALSE],
                      CallusBone_CorticalBone = combined)
  }
  expr_mat <- expr_mat[, sort(colnames(expr_mat)), drop = FALSE]
  return(expr_mat)
}

# --- Save originals before merging
wt_log2cpm_original <- wt_log2cpm
KI_log2cpm_original <- KI_log2cpm

# --- Apply temporary merge
wt_log2cpm <- combine_bone_tissues(wt_log2cpm)
KI_log2cpm <- combine_bone_tissues(KI_log2cpm)

# ============================================================
# Function: get expression table and mark tissue-specific consistency
# (✅ = higher than all other tissues)
# ============================================================

make_marker_table_highlight <- function(expr_mat, marker_list) {
  df_list <- list()
  tissues <- colnames(expr_mat)
  
  for (tissue in names(marker_list)) {
    if (!tissue %in% tissues) {
      warning(sprintf("⚠️ Tissue '%s' not found in expression matrix — skipped.", tissue))
      next
    }
    
    genes <- intersect(marker_list[[tissue]], rownames(expr_mat))
    if (length(genes) == 0) next
    
    df <- as.data.frame(expr_mat[genes, , drop = FALSE])
    df <- cbind(Gene = rownames(df), df)
    
    # ✅ Must be higher in *all* other tissues
    highlight <- sapply(genes, function(g) {
      this_val <- expr_mat[g, tissue]
      others <- expr_mat[g, setdiff(tissues, tissue)]
      all(this_val > others)
    })
    
    df$Highlight <- ifelse(highlight, "✅", "")
    df$Tissue_Assigned <- tissue
    df_list[[tissue]] <- df
  }
  
  if (length(df_list) == 0) return(data.frame())
  dplyr::bind_rows(df_list)
}

# ============================================================
# Build tables for WT and KI
# ============================================================

known_WT_df <- make_marker_table_highlight(wt_log2cpm, known_markers)
known_KI_df <- make_marker_table_highlight(KI_log2cpm, known_markers)

tissue_cols <- colnames(wt_log2cpm)

# ============================================================
# Output collapsible HTML tables
# ============================================================

for (geno in c("WT", "KI")) {
  df <- if (geno == "WT") known_WT_df else known_KI_df
  n_genes <- nrow(df)
  
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — Known Marker Expression (%d markers; ✅ = enriched in own tissue)</strong></summary>\n\n",
              geno, n_genes))
  
  if (n_genes > 0) {
    df$Gene <- ifelse(df$Highlight == "✅",
                      paste0("<strong style='color:#1a9850;'>", df$Gene, "</strong>"),
                      paste0("<span style='color:#999;'>", df$Gene, "</span>"))
    
    print(knitr::kable(df %>% select(Gene, all_of(tissue_cols), Tissue_Assigned),
                       format = "html",
                       escape = FALSE,
                       digits = 2,
                       table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered table-striped text-center' 
                                     style='width:100%; table-layout:auto; word-wrap:break-word;'",
                       caption = paste("Expression of known tissue markers (✅ = higher in assigned tissue vs all others) —", geno)))
  } else {
    cat("<p style='color:#999;'>No known markers passed the all-tissues enrichment rule for this genotype.</p>\n")
  }
  
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> Genes in <strong style='color:#1a9850;'>green bold</strong> are correctly enriched in their assigned tissue (higher than all others). Gray indicates no enrichment detected under this rule.</p>\n")

# ============================================================
# Restore original matrices (keep Bone and Cortical separate for later analyses)
# ============================================================

wt_log2cpm <- wt_log2cpm_original
KI_log2cpm <- KI_log2cpm_original


```

# 5. Downstream Analyses with Pseudobulking for PCA and heatmap generation separated by Genotype and Genotype signature of PCA with GSEA using signature PC loads


```{r PCA, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}

# ============================================================
# PCA, Hierarchical Clustering, and GSEA on PC Loadings per Tissue
# (with PC loadings direction aligned to Genotype)
# ============================================================

library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(knitr)
library(dplyr)
library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(openxlsx)

# --- Hallmark gene sets for mouse ---
msig_hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H") %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)


# --- Output folder ---
dir.create("GSEA_PC_Loadings", showWarnings = FALSE)

cat("<hr><h2>PCA, Hierarchical Clustering, and GSEA on PC Loadings per Tissue</h2>\n")

# Store PC loadings for later GSEA
pca_loadings_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  
  if (is.null(df$KI_count) || is.null(df$WT_count)) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ %s: Missing pseudobulk counts — skipped.\n", tissue))
    next
  }
  
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — PCA & Clustering</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  # --- Build pseudobulk matrix ---
  counts_mat <- as.matrix(df[, c("WT_count", "KI_count")])
  rownames(counts_mat) <- df$Gene
  colnames(counts_mat) <- c("WT", "KI")
  
  # --- Log2CPM normalization ---
  log2cpm <- edgeR::cpm(counts_mat, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)
  
  # --- Keep top 50% variable genes ---
  gene_var <- apply(log2cpm, 1, var)
  cutoff <- quantile(gene_var, 0.5)
  log2cpm_var <- log2cpm[gene_var >= cutoff, , drop = FALSE]
  
  # --- PCA ---
  pca_res <- prcomp(t(log2cpm_var), scale. = TRUE)
  pca_df <- as.data.frame(pca_res$x)
  pca_df$Genotype <- factor(colnames(log2cpm_var), levels = c("WT", "KI"))
  
  # --- Explained variance ---
  var_exp <- pca_res$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res$sdev^2) * 100
  var_df <- data.frame(PC = paste0("PC", 1:length(var_exp)),
                       Variance = var_exp)
  
  p_var <- ggplot(var_df, aes(x = PC, y = Variance)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", fill = "gray70") +
    geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.1f%%", Variance)), vjust = -0.3, size = 3) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
    labs(title = paste("Explained variance per PC —", tissue),
         y = "% Variance Explained", x = "Principal Component") +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(p_var); cat("<br><br>\n")
  
  # --- PCA scatter (PC1–PC2) ---
  pca_plot_df <- pca_df[, c("PC1", "PC2", "Genotype")]
  p <- ggplot(pca_plot_df, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genotype, label = Genotype)) +
    geom_point(size = 4) + geom_text(vjust = -1, size = 4.5) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue", "KI" = "firebrick")) +
    labs(title = paste("PCA —", tissue),
         x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
         y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  print(p); cat("<br><br>\n")
  
  # --- Correlation of each PC with Genotype ---
  geno_numeric <- ifelse(pca_df$Genotype == "KI", 1, 0)
  pc_scores <- pca_res$x
  cor_values <- apply(pc_scores, 2, function(x) cor(x, geno_numeric, method = "pearson"))
  cor_df <- data.frame(PC = names(cor_values), Correlation = cor_values) %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(Correlation)))
  
  cat(sprintf("<strong>%s — Correlation of PCs with Genotype</strong><br>", tissue))
  print(knitr::kable(cor_df, format = "html",
                     digits = 3,
                     table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered table-striped'"))
  cat("<br><br>\n")
  
  # --- Align PCA direction so positive loadings = KI-up ---
  if (cor_values[cor_df$PC[1]] < 0) {
    pca_res$rotation <- -pca_res$rotation
    pca_res$x <- -pca_res$x
  }
  
  # --- Identify PC most associated with genotype ---
  top_pc <- cor_df$PC[1]
  top_pc_index <- as.numeric(gsub("PC", "", top_pc))
  
  # --- Extract top 50 loadings ---
  loadings <- pca_res$rotation[, top_pc_index]
  top_genes <- sort(abs(loadings), decreasing = TRUE)[1:50]
  top_genes_df <- data.frame(Gene = names(top_genes),
                             Loading = loadings[names(top_genes)])
  
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><em>Top 50 gene loadings from %s (aligned to genotype)</em></summary>\n\n", top_pc))
  print(knitr::kable(top_genes_df,
                     format = "html",
                     digits = 4,
                     table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-bordered table-striped'"))
  cat("</details>\n<br>\n")
  
  # Save all loadings (for GSEA later)
  pca_loadings_list[[tissue]] <- data.frame(Gene = names(loadings),
                                            Loading = loadings,
                                            stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  
  # --- Hierarchical clustering heatmap ---
  log2cpm_scaled <- t(scale(t(log2cpm_var)))
  annotation_col <- data.frame(Genotype = c("WT", "KI"))
  rownames(annotation_col) <- colnames(log2cpm_scaled)
  pheatmap(log2cpm_scaled,
           annotation_col = annotation_col,
           show_rownames = FALSE,
           cluster_cols = TRUE,
           cluster_rows = TRUE,
           main = paste("Hierarchical clustering —", tissue),
           color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100))
  cat("<br><br>\n</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> PCA directions are aligned so that positive loadings correspond to genes upregulated in KI.</p>\n")


# ============================================================
# Run GSEA separately on aligned PCA loadings
# ============================================================


# --- Optional Pathway Sets GO and REACTOME ---

#msig_go <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")
#msig_reactome <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")



cat("<hr><h2>GSEA Results per Tissue (Hallmark sets, based on PCA loadings)</h2>\n")

# --- Container for NES across tissues (for heatmap)
gsea_matrix_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(pca_loadings_list)) {
  df <- pca_loadings_list[[tissue]]
  
  if (is.null(df) || nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ %s skipped — no loadings found.\n", tissue))
    next
  }
  
  # --- Build ranked list ---
  gene_ranks <- df$Loading
  names(gene_ranks) <- df$Gene
  gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # --- Run fgsea ---
  fgsea_res <- fgsea(
    pathways = msig_hallmark,
    stats = gene_ranks,
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500,
    nperm = 100000
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # --- Clean pathway names (remove "HALLMARK_" + title case) ---
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("_", " ", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(fgsea_res$pathway))
  
  # --- Add loading values to each leading-edge gene ---
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgsea_res$leadingEdge, function(genes) {
    load_vals <- df$Loading[match(genes, df$Gene)]
    pairs <- paste0(genes, " (", formatC(load_vals, digits = 4, format = "f"), ")")
    paste(pairs, collapse = ", ")
  })
  
  # --- Wrap leadingEdge for better display ---
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- paste0(
    "<div style='white-space:normal; word-wrap:break-word; text-align:left; max-width:600px;'>",
    fgsea_res$leadingEdge,
    "</div>"
  )
  
  # --- Add direction and significance labels ---
  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Significance = case_when(
        padj <= 0.05 ~ "Significant (adj p ≤ 0.05)",
        padj <= 0.25 ~ "Suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25)",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  # --- Filter by raw p-value ≤ 0.1 ---
  fgsea_res_filt <- fgsea_res %>% filter(pval <= 0.1)
  
  # --- Color by adjusted p-value and direction ---
  fgsea_res_filt$pathway <- ifelse(
    fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res_filt$Direction == "Upregulated",
    paste0("<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔴 up
    ifelse(fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res_filt$Direction == "Downregulated",
           paste0("<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔵 down
           ifelse(fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.25,
                  paste0("<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</span>"),  # 🟠 suggestive
                  fgsea_res_filt$pathway))
  )
  
  # --- Store NES for summary heatmap ---

  gsea_matrix_list[[tissue]] <- fgsea_res %>%
    select(pathway, NES) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!rlang::sym(tissue) := NES)

  
  # --- Display collapsible HTML table with smaller font ---
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — GSEA (Hallmark sets, based on PCA loadings)</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  # Remove 'Direction' column before displaying (keep others)
  fgsea_res_filt <- fgsea_res_filt %>% select(-Direction)
  
  print(knitr::kable(
    fgsea_res_filt,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    digits = 3,
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' 
                  style='width:100%; table-layout:auto; word-wrap:break-word; font-size:50%;'",
    caption = paste("Hallmark GSEA Results (p ≤ 0.1 shown) —", tissue)
  ))
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> 
<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>Red bold</strong> = significantly upregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>Blue bold</strong> = significantly downregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>Orange</span> = suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25, raw p ≤ 0.1). 
Leading-edge genes display their PCA loading values in parentheses.</p>\n")

# --- Save for downstream venn diagram comparisons
gsea_pca_list <- gsea_matrix_list


# ============================================================
# --- Summary Heatmap of GSEA NES across Tissues
# ============================================================

cat("<hr><h2>Cross-Tissue Summary — Hallmark GSEA NES Heatmap (from PCA loadings)</h2>\n")

if (length(gsea_matrix_list) > 0) {
  gsea_matrix <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "pathway"), gsea_matrix_list)
  rownames(gsea_matrix) <- gsea_matrix$pathway
  gsea_matrix <- gsea_matrix[, -1]
  gsea_matrix[is.na(gsea_matrix)] <- 0
  
  pheatmap(
    gsea_matrix,
    color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
    main = "Hallmark Pathway Enrichment (NES across tissues — PCA loadings)",
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_cols = TRUE,
    fontsize_row = 6,
    fontsize_col = 10,
    border_color = NA
  )
} else {
  cat("<p style='color:red;'>⚠️ No GSEA results available for heatmap.</p>\n")
}




# ============================================================
# PCA & Hierarchical Clustering for Tissue Identity (pseudobulk)
# ============================================================

library(edgeR)
library(ggplot2)
library(pheatmap)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

cat("<hr><h2>Combined PCA & Hierarchical Clustering — Tissue Identity</h2>\n")

# --- Step 1: Combine all pseudobulk samples (WT & KI per tissue)
combined_counts <- list()

for (tissue in names(log2fc_results_full)) {
  df <- log2fc_results_full[[tissue]]
  if (is.null(df$KI_count) || is.null(df$WT_count)) next
  
  mat <- as.matrix(df[, c("WT_count", "KI_count")])
  rownames(mat) <- df$Gene
  colnames(mat) <- paste(tissue, c("WT", "KI"), sep = "_")
  combined_counts[[tissue]] <- mat
}

# Merge across tissues (keep common genes)
combined_mat <- Reduce(function(x, y) {
  common_genes <- intersect(rownames(x), rownames(y))
  cbind(x[common_genes, ], y[common_genes, ])
}, combined_counts)

cat(sprintf("✅ Combined matrix: %d genes × %d samples\n",
            nrow(combined_mat), ncol(combined_mat)))

# --- Step 2: Log2CPM normalization
log2cpm_combined <- edgeR::cpm(combined_mat, log = TRUE, prior.count = 1)

# --- Step 3: Select top 50% variable genes (across all pseudobulks)
gene_var <- apply(log2cpm_combined, 1, var)
cutoff <- quantile(gene_var, 0.5)
log2cpm_top <- log2cpm_combined[gene_var >= cutoff, , drop = FALSE]

# ============================================================
# Part A: PCA (WT & KI shown separately)
# ============================================================

pca_res_all <- prcomp(t(log2cpm_top), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df_all <- as.data.frame(pca_res_all$x)

# Extract metadata
pca_df_all$Tissue <- sub("_(WT|KI)$", "", rownames(pca_df_all))
pca_df_all$Genotype <- ifelse(grepl("KI$", rownames(pca_df_all)), "KI", "WT")

# Explained variance
var_exp <- pca_res_all$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res_all$sdev^2) * 100

# --- PCA plot colored by Tissue, shaped by Genotype
p_tissue <- ggplot(pca_df_all, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2,
                                   color = Tissue, shape = Genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Combined PCA — Tissue Identity (WT vs KI shown)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
print(p_tissue)
cat("<br><br>\n")

# --- Optional PCA colored by Genotype
p_geno <- ggplot(pca_df_all, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Genotype)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Combined PCA — by Genotype",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp[2], 1), "%)")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("WT" = "steelblue", "KI" = "firebrick")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
print(p_geno)
cat("<br><br>\n")

# ============================================================
# Part B: Averaged WT+KI per tissue (pure tissue identity)
# ============================================================

# --- Compute mean expression across WT and KI for each tissue
avg_by_tissue <- sapply(unique(pca_df_all$Tissue), function(t) {
  cols <- grep(paste0("^", t, "_"), colnames(log2cpm_top))
  rowMeans(log2cpm_top[, cols, drop = FALSE])
})

# --- Run PCA on averaged data
pca_res_avg <- prcomp(t(avg_by_tissue), scale. = TRUE)
pca_df_avg <- as.data.frame(pca_res_avg$x)
pca_df_avg$Tissue <- rownames(pca_df_avg)
var_exp_avg <- pca_res_avg$sdev^2 / sum(pca_res_avg$sdev^2) * 100

# --- PCA plot (pure tissue identity)
p_avg <- ggplot(pca_df_avg, aes(x = PC1, y = PC2, color = Tissue)) +
  geom_point(size = 5) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(title = "Averaged PCA — Pure Tissue Identity (WT+KI mean)",
       x = paste0("PC1 (", round(var_exp_avg[1], 1), "%)"),
       y = paste0("PC2 (", round(var_exp_avg[2], 1), "%)")) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
print(p_avg)
cat("<br><br>\n")

# ============================================================
# Part C: Hierarchical clustering across all pseudobulks
# ============================================================

log2cpm_scaled <- t(scale(t(log2cpm_top)))

annotation_col <- data.frame(
  Tissue = pca_df_all$Tissue,
  Genotype = pca_df_all$Genotype
)
rownames(annotation_col) <- rownames(pca_df_all)

pheatmap(log2cpm_scaled,
         annotation_col = annotation_col,
         show_rownames = FALSE,
         cluster_cols = TRUE,
         cluster_rows = TRUE,
         main = "Hierarchical clustering — Combined Tissues (Tissue Identity)",
         color = colorRampPalette(c("steelblue", "white", "firebrick"))(100))

cat("<p><em>Notes:</em> PCA(A) shows WT/KI separately; PCA(B) shows averaged pure tissue identity.<br>
Hierarchical clustering uses the same top 50% variable genes that define tissue separation.</p>\n")


```



# 6. Downstream DE Analyses

```{r MAST, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}


# ============================================================
# Differential Expression per Tissue using MAST (WT vs KI)
# ============================================================

library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)
library(knitr)

cat("<hr><h2>MAST Differential Expression per Tissue (WT vs KI)</h2>\n")

mast_results_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(gene_filtered_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — MAST differential expression</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  obj <- gene_filtered_list[[tissue]]
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RawCounts"
  
  # --- Rebuild RNA assay for normalization
  obj[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = GetAssayData(obj, slot = "counts"))
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RNA"
  
  # --- LogNormalize (for MAST compatibility)
  obj <- NormalizeData(obj, normalization.method = "LogNormalize", scale.factor = 1e4, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- FindVariableFeatures(obj, selection.method = "vst", nfeatures = 2000, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- ScaleData(obj, features = VariableFeatures(obj), verbose = FALSE)
  
  # --- Check for genotype metadata
  if (!"Genotype" %in% colnames(obj@meta.data)) {
    cat("⚠️ Skipped: no 'Genotype' column found in metadata.\n</details>\n\n")
    next
  }
  
  # --- Ensure Genotype is a factor with WT/KI levels
  obj@meta.data$Genotype <- factor(obj@meta.data$Genotype, levels = c("WT", "KI"))
  
  # --- Set identity for comparison
  Idents(obj) <- obj@meta.data$Genotype
  
  # --- Run MAST
  mast_res <- FindMarkers(
    obj,
    ident.1 = "KI",
    ident.2 = "WT",
    test.use = "MAST",
    logfc.threshold = 0,
    min.pct = 0.05
  )
  
  # --- Add gene names as column
  mast_res <- mast_res %>%
    rownames_to_column("Gene") %>%
    arrange(p_val_adj, desc(avg_log2FC))
  
  mast_results_list[[tissue]] <- mast_res
  
  # --- Display summary
  sig_genes <- sum(mast_res$p_val_adj <= 0.05)
  cat(sprintf("<p><strong>%d significant genes (FDR ≤ 0.05)</strong></p>\n", sig_genes))
  
  # --- Top 50 table
  top50 <- head(mast_res, 50)
  
  # Highlight significant rows
  top50$Gene <- ifelse(
    top50$p_val_adj <= 0.05,
    paste0("<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>", top50$Gene, "</strong>"),
    top50$Gene
  )
  
  print(knitr::kable(
    top50,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    digits = 3,
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center'",
    caption = paste("Top 50 DE genes —", tissue)
  ))
  
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> Genes in <strong style='color:#d9534f;'>red bold</strong> are FDR ≤ 0.05 (MAST adjusted p-value).</p>\n")









# ============================================================
# GSEA on MAST Differential Expression per Tissue (Hallmark sets)
# ============================================================

library(fgsea)
library(msigdbr)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(openxlsx)
library(knitr)

# --- Get Hallmark gene sets for mouse ---
msig_hallmark <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "H") %>%
  split(x = .$gene_symbol, f = .$gs_name)


# --- Optional Pathway Sets GO and REACTOME ---

#msig_go <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C5", subcategory = "BP")
#msig_reactome <- msigdbr(species = "Mus musculus", category = "C2", subcategory = "CP:REACTOME")


cat("<hr><h2>GSEA Results per Tissue (based on MAST log2FC rankings)</h2>\n")

# --- Container for NES across tissues (for summary heatmap)
gsea_mast_list <- list()
gsea_matrix_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(mast_results_list)) {
  mast_res <- mast_results_list[[tissue]]
  
  if (is.null(mast_res) || nrow(mast_res) == 0) {
    cat(sprintf("⚠️ %s: No MAST results found or table empty — skipped.\n", tissue))
    next
  }
  
  # --- Build ranked list (by avg_log2FC) ---
  gene_ranks <- mast_res$avg_log2FC
  names(gene_ranks) <- mast_res$Gene
  gene_ranks <- sort(gene_ranks, decreasing = TRUE)
  
  # --- Run fgsea ---
  fgsea_res <- fgsea(
    pathways = msig_hallmark,
    stats = gene_ranks,
    minSize = 10,
    maxSize = 500,
    nperm = 100000
  ) %>%
    arrange(desc(NES)) %>%
    as_tibble()
  
  # --- Clean pathway names ---
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("^HALLMARK_", "", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- gsub("_", " ", fgsea_res$pathway)
  fgsea_res$pathway <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(fgsea_res$pathway))
  
  # --- Add log2FC values for each leading-edge gene (with more precision) ---
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- sapply(fgsea_res$leadingEdge, function(x) {
    genes <- x
    log2fc_vals <- mast_res$avg_log2FC[match(genes, mast_res$Gene)]
    pairs <- paste0(genes, " (", formatC(log2fc_vals, digits = 4, format = "f"), ")")
    paste(pairs, collapse = ", ")
  })
  
  # --- Wrap leadingEdge for compact display ---
  fgsea_res$leadingEdge <- paste0(
    "<div style='white-space:normal; word-wrap:break-word; text-align:left; max-width:600px;'>",
    fgsea_res$leadingEdge,
    "</div>"
  )
  
  # --- Label significance and direction ---
  fgsea_res <- fgsea_res %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(NES > 0, "Upregulated", "Downregulated"),
      Significance = case_when(
        padj <= 0.05 ~ "Significant (adj p ≤ 0.05)",
        padj <= 0.25 ~ "Suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25)",
        TRUE ~ "NS"
      )
    )
  
  # --- Filter by raw p-value ≤ 0.1 ---
  fgsea_res_filt <- fgsea_res %>% filter(pval <= 0.1)
  gsea_mast_list[[tissue]] <- fgsea_res_filt
  
  # --- Color by direction & adjusted p-value ---
  fgsea_res_filt$pathway <- ifelse(
    fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res_filt$Direction == "Upregulated",
    paste0("<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔴 up
    ifelse(fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.05 & fgsea_res_filt$Direction == "Downregulated",
           paste0("<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</strong>"),  # 🔵 down
           ifelse(fgsea_res_filt$padj <= 0.25,
                  paste0("<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>", fgsea_res_filt$pathway, "</span>"),  # 🟠 suggestive
                  fgsea_res_filt$pathway))
  )
  
  # --- Store NES for cross-tissue summary heatmap ---

  gsea_matrix_list[[tissue]] <- fgsea_res %>%
    select(pathway, NES) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!rlang::sym(tissue) := NES)

  
  # --- Remove Direction column before printing ---
  fgsea_res_filt <- fgsea_res_filt %>% select(-Direction)
  
  # --- Display collapsible HTML table (smaller font) ---
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — GSEA (Hallmark sets, ranked by MAST log2FC)</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  print(knitr::kable(
    fgsea_res_filt,
    format = "html",
    escape = FALSE,
    digits = 3,
    table.attr = "class='table table-sm table-striped table-bordered text-center' 
                  style='width:100%; table-layout:auto; word-wrap:break-word; font-size:50%;' ",
    caption = paste("Hallmark GSEA Results (p ≤ 0.1 shown) —", tissue)
  ))
  
  cat("</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> 
<strong style='color:#d9534f;'>Red bold</strong> = significantly upregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<strong style='color:#0072B2;'>Blue bold</strong> = significantly downregulated (adj p ≤ 0.05); 
<span style='color:#f0ad4e;'>Orange</span> = suggestive (adj p ≤ 0.25, raw p ≤ 0.1).</p>\n")

# ============================================================
# Cross-tissue NES summary heatmap
# ============================================================

cat("<hr><h2>Cross-Tissue Summary — Hallmark GSEA NES Heatmap (MAST log2FC)</h2>\n")

# Merge NES values across tissues
gsea_matrix <- Reduce(function(x, y) full_join(x, y, by = "pathway"), gsea_matrix_list)
rownames(gsea_matrix) <- gsea_matrix$pathway
gsea_matrix <- gsea_matrix[, -1]
gsea_matrix[is.na(gsea_matrix)] <- 0

# Plot heatmap
pheatmap(
  gsea_matrix,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("blue", "white", "red"))(100),
  main = "Hallmark Pathway Enrichment (MAST log2FC ranks)",
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 6,
  fontsize_col = 10,
  border_color = NA
)


```

```{r UMAP, echo=TRUE, results='asis', message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, eval=TRUE}
# ============================================================
# SCTransform Normalization + UMAP Visualization per Tissue
# ============================================================


library(glmGamPoi)
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)

cat("<hr><h2>UMAP Visualization per Tissue (SCTransform normalization)</h2>\n")

umap_list <- list()

for (tissue in names(gene_filtered_list)) {
  cat(sprintf("<details><summary><strong>%s — SCTransform + UMAP</strong></summary>\n\n", tissue))
  
  obj <- gene_filtered_list[[tissue]]
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RawCounts"
  
  # --- SCTransform normalization
  obj <- SCTransform(obj, verbose = FALSE)
  
  # --- Dimensional reduction
  obj <- RunPCA(obj, verbose = FALSE)
  obj <- RunUMAP(obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)
  
  umap_list[[tissue]] <- obj
  
  # --- Compute number of barcodes
  n_cells <- ncol(obj)
  
  # --- UMAP plot colored by Genotype
  p1 <- DimPlot(obj, group.by = "Genotype", pt.size = 1.2) +
    ggtitle(paste0("UMAP — ", tissue, " (colored by Genotype, n = ", n_cells, ")")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  
  # --- UMAP plot colored by nFeature_RNA (QC metric)
  p2 <- FeaturePlot(obj, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 1.2) +
    ggtitle(paste0("UMAP — ", tissue, " (nFeature_RNA, n = ", n_cells, ")")) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"))
  
  # --- Display plots inline
  print(p1)
  cat("<br>\n")
  print(p2)
  cat("<br>\n</details>\n\n")
}

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> Each tissue is normalized independently using SCTransform and displayed with UMAP colored by genotype and QC metrics. Point size increased and sample size (n) added to the legend.</p>\n")



# ============================================================
# Combined UMAP across all tissues — expression-based separation
# ============================================================

library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)

cat("<hr><h2>Combined UMAP — Cross-Tissue Transcriptomic Separation</h2>\n")

# --- Merge all tissue objects into one Seurat object
combined_obj <- NULL
for (tissue in names(gene_filtered_list)) {
  obj <- gene_filtered_list[[tissue]]
  obj$Tissue <- tissue
  DefaultAssay(obj) <- "RawCounts"
  
  if (is.null(combined_obj)) {
    combined_obj <- obj
  } else {
    combined_obj <- merge(combined_obj, y = obj)
  }
}

# --- SCTransform normalization (joint across tissues)
combined_obj <- SCTransform(combined_obj, verbose = FALSE)

# --- Dimensional reduction
combined_obj <- RunPCA(combined_obj, verbose = FALSE)
combined_obj <- RunUMAP(combined_obj, dims = 1:30, verbose = FALSE)

# --- Count cells per Tissue and Genotype (fully safe version)
meta_df <- as.data.frame(combined_obj@meta.data)

# Coerce all list-like columns to character just in case
meta_df[] <- lapply(meta_df, function(x) {
  if (is.list(x)) sapply(x, toString) else x
})

tissue_counts <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Tissue) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Tissue, " (n=", n, ")"))

genotype_counts <- meta_df %>%
  dplyr::count(Genotype) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(label = paste0(Genotype, " (n=", n, ")"))


# --- Replace Tissue and Genotype labels in metadata (safe version)
tissue_label_map <- setNames(tissue_counts$label, tissue_counts$Tissue)
genotype_label_map <- setNames(genotype_counts$label, genotype_counts$Genotype)

combined_obj@meta.data$Tissue_label <- tissue_label_map[as.character(combined_obj@meta.data$Tissue)]
combined_obj@meta.data$Genotype_label <- genotype_label_map[as.character(combined_obj@meta.data$Genotype)]

# --- Plot UMAP colored by Tissue (with counts in legend)
p_tissue <- DimPlot(combined_obj, group.by = "Tissue_label", pt.size = 0.3) +
  ggtitle("Combined UMAP — by Tissue") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

# --- Plot UMAP colored by Genotype (with counts in legend)
p_genotype <- DimPlot(combined_obj, group.by = "Genotype_label", pt.size = 0.3) +
  ggtitle("Combined UMAP — by Genotype") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10))

# --- Display both
print(p_tissue)
cat("<br><br>\n")
print(p_genotype)
cat("<br><br>\n")

cat("<p><em>Note:</em> This UMAP represents global transcriptomic similarity among all tissues.<br>
Tissues forming distinct clusters indicate strong expression-level separation.<br>
The legend now includes the total number of cells (n) per group, which updates automatically each time you re-run this chunk.</p>\n")
```
